name: PT Tempo Scan Pacific Tbk
summary: PT Tempo Scan Pacific Tbk engages in the pharmaceuticals, personal care and cosmetics, and distribution services businesses in Indonesia and internationally. The company operates through Pharmaceuticals, Consumer Products and Cosmetics, and Distribution Services segments. It is involved in the pharmaceutical and medical devices trading; manufacture of soaps, herbal products, powder milk, food and beverages, and plastic packaging; and manufacturing and trading of consumer products, cosmetics, and household products.
